text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A challenge open only to Umamusume worthy 
of being world number one, and the global 
pinnacle that Japan has chased for so 
long— the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among the Umamusume running today, the 
fans cheering them on, and the Trainers, 
there are those who truly aim for that 
pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mei Satake, who arrived at the 
academy, launches a new project for those 
who aspire to win the "Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking on SS Matches and Representative 
Matches, the days advancing toward the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe begin amidst the 
growing hopes of countless fans.
